title: 125-Million-Year-Old Crocodile Fossil Reveals Astonishing New Secrets
description: Ultraviolet imaging of a 125-million-year-old crocodylomorph fossil has revealed unexpectedly detailed traces of skin, sensory structures, and chest cartilage. More than a century after a tiny Early Cretaceous crocodylomorph was unearthed in northeastern Spain, its fossil is revealing details that were hiding in plain sight. title: Police operation takes unexpected turn when officers stumble upon ancient burial cave
description: During a law enforcement operation tied to a violent family conflict, Israel Police discovered a Second Temple period burial cave beneath a building located in Silwan.
